title: Restaurant-Sized Carafe Doesn’t Feel Well-Balanced
text:
Restaurant-Sized Carafe Doesn’t Feel Well-Balanced. This TIGER THERMAL INSULATED CARAFE (68-Ounce, Stainless) is a restaurant-sized carafe. That means it is heavy when filled with liquid. However, it doesn’t feel well-balanced when you are holding it by the rather short handle.

A little lever on the stopper, above the handle, allows you to pour liquid from the carafe. The lever merely lifts an inner stopper, so you must hold the lever down at all times while you are pouring. Filling the carafe is awkward, because the stopper must be twisted completely around (unscrewed) to open the carafe.

What I expected was a simple double-walled stainless steel carafe, something along the lines of my stainless thermos bottles and travel cups. So I was surprised by the extensive safety, use, and cleaning instructions (see photos).

My preference in a thermal carafe for personal or family use is for something smaller and easier to care for, even if it doesn’t do as good a job of keeping the contents hot or cold.
